truth_boundary.note: Baseline copied from current project doctrine; re-read authoritative ledgers before any future update.

gauntlet.rule: No candidate passes merely by being listed. PASS only authorizes proposing a bounded test.

hypotheses.name: Residential construction quote-risk report
hypotheses.buyer: Builder, developer, or quantity surveyor reviewing a real quote
hypotheses.value_hypothesis: A source-linked report identifies omissions, scope mismatches, exclusions, assumptions, and anomalies early enough to justify a paid review.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Run existing synthetic fixtures, then one permissioned real quote reviewed independently; record false positives, misses, time, and corrections.
hypotheses.risk: Professional liability, incomplete inputs, false confidence, unproven time saved.

hypotheses.name: Truth Oracle evidence-backed economic brief
hypotheses.buyer: Professional or operator making a consequential decision
hypotheses.value_hypothesis: A reproducible brief separating facts, estimates, assumptions, and unknowns beats an unstructured answer for some decisions.
hypotheses.monetization_hypothesis: One-off brief first; subscription only if repeat use is demonstrated.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Create one source-linked sample and get qualified buyer feedback before building subscription mechanics.

hypotheses.name: Quote comparison and decision audit
hypotheses.buyer: SMB or household comparing consequential supplier quotes
hypotheses.value_hypothesis: Normalising scope, exclusions, assumptions, and total cost reduces comparison effort and missed differences.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Validate known-answer synthetic fixtures and one permissioned real comparison; production checkout stays held.

hypotheses.name: Evidence provenance and verification API
hypotheses.buyer: Developer or business integrating evidence checks
hypotheses.value_hypothesis: A narrow provenance/status endpoint saves bespoke integration work.
hypotheses.monetization_hypothesis: Compare subscription with included quota and overage against usage-only pricing after usage costs are measured.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Define one narrow API contract and test it locally before implementing metering or billing.

hypotheses.name: NZ business identity and risk brief
hypotheses.buyer: SMB supplier, purchaser, or professional checking a counterparty
hypotheses.value_hypothesis: A dated brief from permitted public business sources reduces manual lookup time.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Create a source-only sample and validate usefulness, source rights, and freshness with a target buyer.

hypotheses.name: MTG Commander deck diagnostic
hypotheses.value_hypothesis: A reproducible diagnostic provides practical value beyond free deck advice.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Compare an internal sample against a documented decklist and independent expert review.

hypotheses.name: Reusable silo-factory implementation package
hypotheses.buyer: Operator needing a bounded catalogue-to-offer workflow
hypotheses.value_hypothesis: A validated template with tests, provenance, and fulfillment contracts is more valuable than a generic website clone.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Use MTG as reference and document current blockers; do not copy inventory or claim production readiness.

hypotheses.name: Curated economic encyclopedia with evidence submissions
hypotheses.buyer: Professionals needing maintained, auditable economic knowledge
hypotheses.value_hypothesis: A curated append-only corpus with public evidence intake can support paid reports, exports, APIs, or workflows after usage and willingness-to-pay are shown.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Define and test submission, review, versioning, and publication boundaries before monetization.

replication_policy.initial_batch: 5-10 bounded experiments only after Elohim prioritises and Gauntlet accepts them
replication_policy.scale: Support the top 1-2 only when comparative evidence justifies it
replication_policy.stop: Archive failed or dominated candidates with reasons
replication_policy.compounding: Require interface, provenance, licence/dependencies, tests/fixtures, reproduction steps, and a later comparable run measuring net time/cost/quality change.
